sources.snippet: The AMD MI300X features 192 GB of HBM3 memory and 5.3 TB/s bandwidth, making it one of the most capable accelerators for serving large language models. This project explores practical inference optimizations — including quantization, KV-cache management, and batch scheduling — to maximize throughput and minimize latency on MI300X hardware.
